name: IRAS 23077+6707

paper.title: Hubble reveals complex multi-scale structure in the edge-on protoplanetary disk IRAS 23077+6707
High-resolution Pan-STARRS and SMA observations of IRAS 23077+6707: A giant edge-on protoplanetary disk

notes: "Dracula's Chivito": one of the largest known edge-on protoplanetary disks (~14 arcsec, ~4200 au at an adopted distance of 300 pc), serendipitously discovered in Pan-STARRS imaging by Berghea et al. 2024 (arXiv:2402.01063). No accurate parallax is available due to its extended size; distance of 300 pc is adopted from Gaia extinction mapping and is broadly consistent with membership in the Cepheus star-forming region (150-800 pc). Hidden central star estimated as hot, ~A9/8000 K.
